messages:
Nina (Partnerships): Quick check: final production handoff for the Partner Roundtable next Tue. Need: speaker order, bilingual MC script (EN/ES), demo-lending shelf plan for partners, localized swag tags, and API fallback snippet. Can we lock by EOD Mon?
Omar (Marketplace): I'll push the marketplace tile text for approval. Also need partners to confirm logo SVG and short blurb by tomorrow noon.
Priya (Marketing): Localization note: translators can spot-check slides into Spanish + French. We should also print bilingual QR postcards. Volunteers to help hand out non-tee swag?
Zoe (Events): Volunteer slots: 09:00-11:30, 11:30-14:00, 14:00-17:00. Need two per slot; will post signup. AV: 2 lapels, HDMI matrix, 1 spare laptop. Green room 25m prior.
Luca (Hardware PM): Demo-lending shelf: we'll bring a loaner edge devkit for partners who can't ship hardware. Need a locked cabinet and 2 foam-lined cases for transport. Also request a dedicated 220V circuit for the rack.
Diego (Eng): Fallback plan if Dedicated throttles: hosted API (region=us-west-2) + model=redwood-lite-quant; pre-warming job will run. Curl snippet for partners: ```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.inference/v1/generate \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"model":"redwood-lite-quant","prompt":"<prompt>","max_tokens":120}'
```
Nina (Partnerships): Love the snippet. Also partners asked about a private partner dinner after the run (RSVP only). Can we confirm a headcount room for 18 at 19:30?
Priya (Marketing): Yes we can book. Also swag idea: regional postcard copy + a unique digital promo code printed on the card (one-use per attendee). We should log codes per partner for analytics.
Customs Bot: Freight update: swag pallet TRK-88122 ETA Fri 06:15. For EU items, HS code 4911.99.90 recommended for printed material. Will prepend "promotional samples" on invoice.
Luca (Hardware PM): For international partners, we need a letter of intent for customs; I'll upload template. Also will label loaner units as "demo units - not for resale."
Zoe (Events): Can Ops pre-provision an isolated demo VLAN? Venue asked for IP range. If denied, we'll bring a local router and pre-seed models offline.
Diego (Eng): Ops will run warmup pings every 10m for the fallback endpoint starting 30m pre-show. If VLAN unavailable, I'll provide an offline demo bundle and a recording.
Omar (Marketplace): Note: marketplace approval needs final blurb by Mon 11:00 to make the tile live post-demo. I'll ping partners for final signoff.
Nina (Partnerships): Final checklist: upload bilingual slides, 60s fallback clip, static fallback slide, logo SVGs, and RSVP list for dinner. Add unresolved items as comments in the runbook doc. Dry-run Tue 16:00; be in green room 25m early. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
